# oh-my-harness

> Independent plugins and trusted Python skills for DeepSeek Harness: persistent Python, running-instance control, task-oriented browser/macOS/SSH operations, events, and context helpers. Not affiliated with DeepSeek. Trusted execution is not a sandbox.

The Chinese README is the primary, default documentation; the paired English documents cover the same behavior. Exact settings and platform constraints live in component READMEs. Complete values can remain in a session kernel while only evidence is displayed. Do not assume a short display proves a complete source or that an accepted request completed an external action.

## Start

- [Overview and installation](README.en.md): Host/extension boundary, quick start, comparisons, security, and documentation map.
- [中文说明](README.md): Primary Chinese introduction.
- [Security](SECURITY.en.md): Trust boundaries and GitHub private vulnerability reporting.
- [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.en.md): Scope, component environments, evidence, and review.
- [Agent guidance](AGENTS.md): Instructions for authorized changes in this repository.

## Capability guides

- [Python kernel](docs/dsh-python-repl.en.md): Persistent cells, complete values, snapshots, and limits.
- [Control and supervision](docs/dsh-control.en.md): Existing-instance access, receipts, settled state, and controller/worker workflow.
- [Monitor](docs/dsh-monitor.en.md): Producer events, delivery modes, lifecycle, and gaps.
- [Output guard](docs/dsh-output-guard.en.md): Model-stream detection and bounded retry.
- [Compaction](docs/dsh-compaction-bound.en.md): Retention, exact-user-text indexing, and history-reader guidance.
- [Message tidy](docs/dsh-message-tidy.en.md): Instruction diffs and provenance-aware notices.
- [Image cap](docs/dsh-image-cap.en.md): Request image limits and resizing constraints.
- [History cap](docs/dsh-history-cap.en.md): UI history pagination, not model token limits.
- [Browser control](docs/browser-control.en.md): Explicit CDP pages and cooperative task ownership.
- [Computer control](docs/computer-control.en.md): Native macOS targets, input, and result inspection.
- [Remote host](docs/remote-host.en.md): Real SSH destinations and content verification.

## Design and evidence

- [Data locality](docs/design/python-data-locality.en.md): Values, displays, persistence, and recovery.
- [Three generations of compaction](docs/design/three-generations-of-compaction.en.md): Historical choices and the current bounded host extension.
- [Controller and worker](docs/design/controller-worker.en.md): Receipts, observation, and independent acceptance.
- [Task isolation](docs/design/task-isolation.en.md): Shared accounts/desktops and target ownership.
- [Output boundaries](docs/design/output-guard.en.md): Display budgets, stream guards, and producer history.
- [Reproducible measurements](benchmarks/README.en.md): Fictional workloads, explicit estimates, and offline commands.
- [Measured output](benchmarks/results.json): Actual deterministic results with production source hashes.
- [Recording checklist](docs/assets/README.en.md): Real-media recording and verification requirements; a placeholder is not a completed demonstration.
